sections.title: Using the MSCAN assistant
sections.excerpt: The assistant uses the selected sample and active result tab. QC inputReads is the input count; readsAfterQC is the count after quality control; readsAfterHostRemoval is the remaining count after host removal. Null means unavailable, not zero. Ask the assistant in chat to pull sample files or push results to a named project and sample. Agent runs and downloaded artifacts remain associated with your account. Changing pages updates context; it does not cancel a running analysis.
